doc: Tier S research institution programme (46 layers). Data; scripts/check_tier_s_program.py is its gate and renders docs/research/TIER_S_PROGRAM.md.
admission_rule: A subsystem ships only with a measurable contract (gain in: ALPHA_DISCOVERY, FALSIFICATION, INFO_PER_COMPUTE, FDR_REDUCTION, CALIBRATION, EXECUTION_CAPTURE, OPERATIONAL_RISK, PRODUCTIVITY). Evaluated hourly by tier_s.contracts: ADMITTED, REJECTED or UNMEASURED. Blueprint CLOSED 2026-09-29: no new categories.

statuses.DONE: attested by the trading box: its artifact is fresh on the box and its contract is not REJECTED (data/tier_s/box_evidence.json, written by the box's own tier_s pass)
statuses.PARTIAL: runs hourly; `remaining` names what the wording asks that it does not yet do
statuses.BLOCKED_ON_USER: research side runs; the money-path consumer is refused by this environment's permission rule
statuses.BLOCKED_ON_BOX: needs the trading box (a sandbox or state only it holds)
statuses.BUILT: code complete, wired hourly and tested; not DONE until the trading box attests its artifact
